app.title: AudioExtractor
app.subtitle: Audio extractor
version.label: Version {version}
drop.title: Drop recordings or a folder
save.title: Save the audio as
pick.title: Choose video or audio files
working.title: Extracting the audio…
done.title: Done
error.title: Something went wrong
error.failed: The audio could not be extracted from this file. Try again, or try another file.
error.no-audio: This video has no sound, so there is nothing to extract. Check that the recording was made with audio.
format.label: Output format
error.unreadable: This file is damaged or not finished yet. If it comes from Zoom, wait for Zoom to finish converting the recording, then try again. If you downloaded it, download it again.
error.not-media: This file is not a video or audio recording. Choose an MP4 or another recording.
error.destination-unwritable: The audio could not be saved in that folder. Choose another folder, such as Documents, and check that there is free space.
error.output-locked: A file with that name is open in another program. Close it, or save under a different name, then try again.
folder.title: Choose where to save the audio files
error.empty-folder: This folder has no video or audio files. Drop the recordings themselves, or choose another folder.
error.unsupported-format: This kind of file isn't supported. AudioExtractor works with MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, M4A, MP3, WAV and AAC files.
error.same-as-source: Choose a different name: this is the original file.
busy.title: AudioExtractor is busy
busy.message: Busy: try again when the current job finishes.
